citedPaper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as autonomous subordinates that carry out tasks for users. citedPaper.abstract: This paper introduces a dynamic and actionable framework for securing agentic AI systems in enterprise deployment. Through failure mode and helpfulness analysis, we summarize two fundamental safety defects in current LLM agents: lack of robustness and lack of risk awareness. Furthermore, our findings suggest that reliance on defense prompts alone may be insufficient to address these safety issues, emphasizing the need for more advanced and robust strategies. citedPaper.abstract: Language model (LM) agents are increasingly being used to automate complicated tasks in digital environments.
